crossRefs.note: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in…
For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.
Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in…
Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is…
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

translations.web: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.
translations.bsb: Nations writhe in horror before them; every face turns pale.
translations.kjv: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
translations.asv: At their presence the peoples are in anguish; all faces are waxed pale.
